G0132.name: Aeneas
G0132.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0132.brief: Paralyzed man in Lydda healed by Peter
G0132.short: Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years, was healed by Peter in Lydda.

G0107.name: Azor
G0107.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G0107.brief: Ancestor of Jesus Christ in the genealogy of Matthew
G0107.short: Azor was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Matthew (<ref="Matt 1:13, 14">Matt 1:13, 14</ref>).

G0137.name: Aenon
G0137.brief: A place near Salim where John the Baptist baptized.
G0137.short: Aenon, a site near Salim where John the Baptist conducted baptisms.

G0184.name: Akeldama
G0184.brief: Field purchased with Judas' betrayal money; burial place for strangers
G0184.short: Akeldama, also known as the Field of Blood or Potter's Field, was purchased with the money Judas received for betraying Jesus and used as a burial place for foreigners.

G0116.name: Athens
G0116.brief: A major city in Greece, visited by Paul.
G0116.short: Athens, the intellectual and cultural center of ancient Greece, where Paul preached the gospel and addressed the Areopagus.
G0116.meaning: “city of Athena,” named for the Greek goddess
